Autonomous payments for AI agents. MCP server + SDK for the Machine Payments Protocol. Settlement runs transparently on-chain, in USDG, on Robinhood Chain 4663.

Pons MCP bridges AI agents with Stripe's Machine Payments Protocol, enabling autonomous service payments with transparent Robinhood Chain settlement.

- MPP Integration
Native support for Stripe's Machine Payments Protocol. Agents discover services, interpret 402 responses, and authorize payments.

- On-chain Settlement
USDG transfers settle transparently on Robinhood Chain (4663). Every payment ends with a verifiable receipt.

- Policy Protection
Per-transaction and daily caps are enforced before any funds move. Balance is checked before broadcast.

- Local Key Control
Signing lives in the configured MCP server process — never in the browser, never in third-party code.

- pons Intelligence
Read pons v1 launch metadata, canonical pools, socials, and live markets directly from agent tool calls.

- Receipt Verification
A payment is complete only when the on-chain receipt confirms the exact USDG transfer to the merchant.

PLEDGE is a stock-token loan desk with its token launching through Pons on Robinhood Chain. The desk reads Aave V4’s Equities Hub and MAG7 Spoke on Base, where seven Coinbase stock tokens (B20), representing Apple, Amazon, Alphabet, Meta, Microsoft, Nvidia and Tesla, can serve as collateral for USDC loans for eligible users outside the US.

Enter stock-token amounts and adjust the borrowing slider to inspect a combined borrowing limit, basket health factor, estimated monthly cost and uniform price decline to the liquidation boundary. The calculations include collateral factors, supply caps, available USDC, oracle valuations and token-to-share multipliers.

Prices carry their oracle feed times; market parameters carry their read-block time. A stateless market reader uses a 30-second shared cache and a public RPC fallback in the browser. Failed reads retain the last good value with its original timestamp.

Optional wallet access reads supported balances without requesting a signature or submitting a transaction. Estimates can be saved as PNG or text with their source times.

The actual loan is reviewed and taken through the official Aave app. PLEDGE does not lend or hold collateral. If collateral value falls too far, Aave can sell the tokens. The loan and borrowing costs must be repaid.
